Methyl (3α,16α)-14,15-dihydro-14β-hy- droxyeburnamenine-14-carboxylate. Винкамин C21H26N2O3 = 354.4. CAS — 1617-90-9. ATC — C04AX07. ATC Vet — QC04AX07. Pharmacopoeias. In Fr. Profile Vincamine is an alkaloid obtained from Vinca minor (Apocy- naceae). It is claimed to increase cerebral circulation and utilisa- tion of oxygen and has been used in a variety of cerebral disorders. Vincamine may have adverse effects on the cardiovas- cular system and care should be taken in patients with hyperten- sion or cardiac dysfunction. Vincamine salts including vincamine hydrochloride, oxoglurate, teprosilate, and hydrogen tartrate have also been used.
